tier1.text: The semitendinosus bends the knee, a movement called knee flexion. This muscle also extends the hip, moving the thigh backward. The semitendinosus lies at the back of the thigh, toward the inner side. This muscle is one of the hamstrings, a group of three muscles that all bend the knee.

quotes.quote: Knee flexion is the bending of the knee to bring the foot toward the posterior thigh, and extension is the straightening of the knee.
